name: ccxt
title_zh: 一套代码接 100+ 交易所，换所不换语法
tagline_zh: 写策略最怕换所重写。ccxt 把币安、OKX、Bybit 等 100+ 交易所统一成同一套方法。
tagline_en: Tired of rewriting strategies per exchange? ccxt unifies 100+ venues (Binance, OKX, Bybit…) behind one API in.
desc_en: A unified trading API with more than 100 crypto exchanges and prediction markets in JavaScript / TypeScript / Python / C# / PHP / Go / Java / Rust
why_zh: 不是包装纸，是协议层：每个交易所的私有方法、限频、签名差异都被压成同一套 fetch_ticker/c…
why_en: Not a wrapper—a protocol. Rate limits, auth, and method quirks of each venue are normalized into fetch_ticker/create_order. 10.
limit_zh: 只管下单和行情，不含策略、风控、资金管理。WebSocket 支持参差，部分新所高频推送要自己补。
limit_en: Trading & market data only—no strategy, risk, or portfolio logic. WebSocket coverage varies; some newer venues need custom streams. Default rate.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: One API for 100+ crypto exchanges, swap venues without.
